caseName: Firestone Tire & Rubber Co. v. Board of Supervisors
caseNameFull: FIRESTONE TIRE & RUBBER CO. v. BOARD OF SUPERVISORS OF LOS ANGELES COUNTY
attorneys: Oscar A. Trip-pet and Thomas H. Carver for appellant.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The appeal is dismissed. Treating the papers whereon the appeal was taken as a petition for writ of certiorari, certiorari is denied.
